headline: The rulings propagate; the amendments, the assets and the anchors do not. Five mechanical checks built, wired into the pre-commit gate, and proven red on reintroduced real instances.
could_not_do: THIS IS A SAMPLE, NOT A SWEEP. 267 governing documents were scanned for five mechanical shapes. Everything asserted in ordinary English is invisible to that and always will be.

The single highest-blast-radius finding — RI-VIS02's false 'image files are not vendored into this repo', which had been false for eight days — WAS NOT FOUND BY ANY CHECK. It has no path in the sentence, so check C could not resolve it. I found it by hand. A green run means 'the five shapes I can decide are clean', never 'the documents are current'.
Five findings are handed over rather than fixed, because the files have live owners (Ruling O1). Each carries an acceptance criterion in report §6.

Question 4 (stale counts) is answered structurally, not exhaustively. I did not re-derive every figure in the corpus. I established that unstamped numbers are the general condition and built the check for the one sub-shape recomputation can never catch (D).
The commit-stamp check that §5 argues for is NOT BUILT. Its false-positive rate needs work I did not have budget for. It is rank 3 in the queue.
Check B's warning tier is not triaged: 18 asset directories named only by inventory. I confirmed the two that matter and left 16 ranked.

Check C has a known false-positive class I deliberately did not suppress: a claim about command output ('`git diff ...` is empty') reads as a claim about the path in the command. One live instance (W1-DLG-TOPIC-WEB.md:144). Suppressing it would also have suppressed INTENT-AUDIT-02's genuinely stale grep.
No browser work and no game runtime — text and tooling only, as briefed. No claim here rests on anything rendered.

key_findings.arbitration_md_is_clean: §2's append-only rule is honoured. Zero governing documents cite an overruled S-ruling (check A1). The rot is one level down.
key_findings.highest_blast_radius: RI-VIS02 asserted image files are not vendored; 131 files are, and ARBITRATION S55 already contradicted it in its own words. BAR-CRITIQUE-IMAGES-02 item 17 flagged this exact sentence and it was never applied.
key_findings.mygui_shape_at_scale: corpus/70-visual/refs/souls-behaviour/ holds 282 behaviour references including 177 named DS1 boss-move GIFs, cited by no item in 10-combat/. RI-AI06 is called 'boss design'.
key_findings.fourth_instance_confirmed: thorn n=0 is a property of anchor REF-A3 (0 of 5 composition-valid, all square crops). stormhold is WORSE and not the same defect: anchor REF-A17 is in board.json's own slot_routing.interior while the zeroed rows are ROOFLINE-RELIEF and SKY-FRACTION — skyline statistics. 0 of 6 sky-visible. A category error, unmovable by acquisition.
key_findings.remediation_that_cannot_run: board.json's fill_command passes --shots to docs/art-direction/measure-plates.mjs, which parses only --out. The documented fix runs, exits 0, recomputes the same population and reproduces n=0 exactly.
key_findings.convention_not_edits: Every stale figure fixed here was unstamped. RULES.md rule 12 and COST.md prevention rule 1 already say to stamp; neither is enforced anywhere. The remedy is a convention change, said so rather than starting a hundred edits.
key_findings.cost_md_contradicted_claude_md: COST.md §5 asserted the parallelism floor of 12 while CLAUDE.md has said it is removed since the 2026-08-14 directives.
